study.question: Does allowing the residual task relevance scorer to read the existing feedback memory improve on g3-r0012-memory_task_private_linear (validation macro AUC 0.8310755947860231), both frozen source bests, and a parameter-matched static-query replacement? Is any memory-source benefit larger with private task routing than mean routing?
study.hypothesis: Observation: the R12 private/linear combination improves over g0 by 0.0006966769079054 macro AUC, whereas mean/linear, private/copy and mean/copy reach 0.830471497201018, 0.8306211408644399 and 0.8303725090131304. Private-vs-mean is especially visible in purchase AUC, but private/linear scarcely changes purchase AUC versus g0 and slightly regresses click. Inspection shows _task_pool receives only target, event item/action embeddings and masks; the full-sequence g0 feedback memory can affect shared tokens but cannot change the task scorer conditional on the same event. Provisional mechanism: a history-conditioned shift before the shared nonlinear scorer activation lets identical target/event pairs receive different task relevance in different feedback contexts. This may make the two source approaches cooperate beyond their current parallel use. These observations do not establish that this missing connection is harmful, and a null outcome is admissible.

study.proposed_difference: In each new cell compute q_static as the FP32 mean (restored to token dtype) of six target-field tokens immediately before FeedbackMemory, including their existing field projection and token identity. Compute q_memory from the SAME positions immediately after FeedbackMemory and before JointBlock. Select q_memory or q_static, apply one bias-free zero-initialized map Wc:[32,64], and add Wc(q) to each event preactivation of the shared task-trunk Linear before its existing Dice. No history-dependent direct logit shortcut is added. Both sources, all scorer heads, content and linear-rank pools execute in every cell. Cross context source memory/static with routing private/mean. Wc=0 restores the corresponding R12 routing function at arbitrary inherited weights; all newly initialized cells also start with zero scorer outputs. There is no detachment, extra input, loss change or frozen-training change.
predictions: Primary prediction: memory_context_private exceeds both static_context_private and the immediate R12 incumbent on full validation macro AUC; also report comparisons to DIN, g0 and g3. A gain only over g0 but below R12 does not improve the entry state.

Specificity prediction: D_private = AUC(memory_context_private)-AUC(static_context_private) is positive and exceeds D_mean = AUC(memory_context_mean)-AUC(static_context_mean). Report interaction I=D_private-D_mean. I<=0 with D_private>0 supports at most generic context conditioning, not added task-specific synergy.

At fixed trained weights with nonzero memory update, context map and scorer final weights, changing a valid historical feedback mask can change memory-source task pooling. Static-source task pooling is invariant to that mask at fixed target/keys/actions/values. Shared model predictions may change in ALL cells through the inherited memory path; this is not a full-model invariance claim.

At fixed inherited weights and empty history, memory and static query contexts are identical and residual task pooling is zero; source choice cannot directly improve that example. Independently trained models can still differ on empty-history examples through shared parameter changes.

Exploratory history slices reuse existing bins 0, 1-16, 17-64, >64 with task-wise sample/positive/negative counts; history/context effects are plausible on nonempty histories. No monotonic length effect or unseen causal timestamp is assumed.
falsifiers: Memory-source private fails to exceed matched static-source private, or a static input map reproduces its entire gain: no support for useful feedback-memory conditioning in this implementation.

No improvement over immediate R12 incumbent, even if a source best is exceeded: no new performance advance. A small one-seed gain that reverses across paired host repetitions remains preliminary or unsupported.
Private/mean source interaction is zero or negative: no evidence that the new memory connection specifically improves task-dependent routing; retain any generic-context finding separately.

Context projection/scorer/memory sensitivity remains zero after deliberately opening relevant zero-start layers, invalid IDs affect outputs, target action affects predictions, or required FP32/BF16/full-batch gates fail: implementation/integrity failure rather than a scientific mechanism refutation.
Added cost exceeds trial cap, device memory, or available campaign reserve: infeasible within this protocol; stop without changing frozen data, batch, precision or other host settings.
alternative_explanations: Source selection intentionally changes upstream gradient destinations as well as representations; this experiment tests the full learnable connection, not pure inference information alone.
Memory-conditioned source has a broader functional input than static source despite equal added parameters; this is the intended information contrast, not proof of equal hypothesis-class capacity.
Averaging task scores has lower effective functional freedom than private routing although nominal parameters and forward operators match.
Single-pass optimization and one screening seed can dominate small differences; validation is already used for adaptive research.
Extra context parameters or field reparameterization may explain gains; static-source replacement has the same 2048 additional trainable parameters.

Nonlinear Dice batch coupling and altered shared-memory gradients can affect optimization without providing the hypothesized per-example context information. In eval-mode cloned diagnostics, intervene on memory output/source while holding weights and non-memory inputs fixed.

The source-aware map and memory output start at zero; slow gradient opening under one training pass can make a promising connection look ineffective. Inspect finite/live gradients and context scale before interpreting a null result, without extra epochs or retuning host learning rates.

Rare auxiliary labels and repeated users can produce noisy AUC differences. No seed significance or per-impression independent uncertainty claim; use paired user-cluster bootstrap only if host supplies authorized identities/predictions.
Official offline feedback visibility and category/brand-based 24h labels may make context effects benchmark-specific; no production point-in-time or advertisement conversion claim.
